bootstrap.method: paired task percentile; linear interpolation at quantiles
bootstrap.sampling: sample complete task contrast values with replacement, retaining all contributing conditions
bootstrap.random_stream: independent Random(seed) initialized for each contrast; sorted task IDs
bootstrap.multiplicity: No multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory p-values; report all three prespecified contrasts and intervals

missingness.primary: complete tasks per contrast, no imputation; genuine provider/filter/infrastructure failures missing
missingness.condition_means: all completed trajectories, plus matched-subset means for each contrast
missingness.interaction: only tasks with all four Model A conditions completed
missingness.sensitivity: all planned tasks; provider/filter failures zero end-to-end utility; unresolved harness failures remain missing
missingness.valid_format_sensitivity: paired tasks whose contributing Turn-2 file transactions all parse
missingness.report: planned/completed/provider-failed/harness-unresolved counts by condition, paired sample size per contrast

format.transaction: atomic; malformed/unsafe/duplicate/unknown file blocks apply no edits
format.primary_tcs: zero for malformed file transaction; otherwise hidden requirement score
format.artifact_score: preserved-workspace hidden score reported separately, even for format failure
format.checklist: separate from file transaction; malformed/missing claims never invalidate otherwise valid code
format.truncation_or_refusal: model behavior, no generation retry; score format/artifacts and offer the fixed second turn
format.parseable_omissions: unreturned editable files retain preceding snapshot

self_assessment.missing: distinct missing label; included in actual-failure denominator, never acknowledgement or implemented
self_assessment.duplicates_unknown_malformed: parse_files.parse_claims is authoritative; duplicate known IDs become missing; unknown/malformed rows are logged and ignored; not exactly one checklist makes all claims missing
self_assessment.aggregation: primary descriptive ratio of summed numerator/denominator counts per model/condition/turn; secondary equal-task mean of defined task ratios
self_assessment.zero_denominator: JSON null / CSV empty / report NA; report numerator, denominator, and count of defined tasks
self_assessment.uncertainty: no requirement-independent significance tests; task bootstrap only if an interval is added

analysis.null_interpretation: wide intervals are inconclusive; no universal model-population effect; never equate nonsignificance with no effect

sensitivity_design.formula: 1.96 * paired_contrast_sd / sqrt(n); planning approximation, not power or a promised bootstrap width

normalization: SHA-256 of file bytes with CRLF and CR normalized to LF; UTF-8 text artifacts
